disposition_reason: Table 4 prints mean total mercury by brand for six Yemeni canned tuna brands bought in Sana'a.

study.design: retail survey of locally canned tuna brands
study.period_text: collection dates not stated; production dates on cans 2020
study.method: direct mercury analyzer (DMA-80, EPA 7473) on drained homogenized meat
study.lod_text: LOD 0.324 ng and LOQ 1.08 ng absolute (abstract: 1.62 ppb and 5.4 ppb)

findings.group: Yemeni canned light tuna in sunflower oil, small/soft, brand I, made in Almukulla, produced 11.01.2020, Sana'a stores
findings.notes: Oil squeezed out before homogenizing; basis as analyzed (drained meat), not stated as wet or dry. Text prints 56.84 ± 1.64.

findings.group: Yemeni canned light tuna in sunflower oil, large pieces, brand II, made in Almukulla, produced 11.01.2020, Sana'a stores
findings.notes: Oil squeezed out before homogenizing; basis as analyzed (drained meat), not stated as wet or dry.

findings.group: Yemeni canned white tuna in soybean oil, large pieces, brand III, made in Almukulla, produced 08.09.2020, Sana'a stores
findings.notes: Oil squeezed out before homogenizing; basis as analyzed (drained meat), not stated as wet or dry.

findings.group: Yemeni canned white tuna in sunflower oil, large pieces, brand IV, made in Alshr, produced 06.06.2020, Sana'a stores
findings.notes: Oil squeezed out before homogenizing; basis as analyzed (drained meat), not stated as wet or dry.

findings.group: Yemeni canned yellow tuna in soybean oil, large pieces, brand VI, made in Albidha, produced 09.09.2020, Sana'a stores
findings.notes: Oil squeezed out before homogenizing; basis as analyzed (drained meat), not stated as wet or dry. Text attributes the highest value (387.85 ± 6.37) to brand IV made in Albidha; Table 4 lists it as brand VI.

findings.group: Yemeni canned yellow tuna in vegetable oil, large pieces, brand VII, made in Almukulla, produced 20.06.2020, Sana'a stores
findings.notes: Oil squeezed out before homogenizing; basis as analyzed (drained meat), not stated as wet or dry.

regulatory_or_exposure.what: Yemeni (YSMO) limit for Hg in canned tuna, as cited

unresolved: Abstract and methods say 31 samples from seven brands, but Table 4 lists six brands (no brand V) totalling 27 samples.
Discussion states the brand range as 56.84-387.85 mg/kg; the table unit is ppb (µg/kg), which matches the 500 ppb limit; the mg/kg wording is a text error.
Brand attribution of the highest value differs between text (IV) and table (VI).
Individual-sample values appear only in Figure 2; not extracted.
